items.question: What identity and structural features characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is being identified in sequence.
It is designated by the name or epithet rājāna.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is the royal cakra, characterized by eight petals and a central pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a descriptive epithet is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
